entries.name: v39_journey_digest
entries.purpose: Absorb the latest journey text into an advisory-only digest without mutating repo truth.
entries.rollback_or_cleanup: delete digest outputs if superseded; no live cloud state created

entries.name: v39_stage_allowlist
entries.purpose: Freeze the curated V39 stage set and keep unrelated dirty churn out of the publication lane.
entries.rollback_or_cleanup: regenerate if the curated file set changes

entries.name: agent_engine_forensics_lane
entries.purpose: Pull operation state, Cloud Logging evidence, package alignment, and staging state for the failed Agent Engine runtime.

entries.name: agent_engine_minimal_probe_lane
entries.purpose: Deploy a fresh minimal Agent Engine with pinned requirements and a unique staging prefix, then verify list/get/query.
entries.rollback_or_cleanup: delete the fresh minimal reasoning engine only if it becomes healthy and later needs cleanup

entries.name: kai_consultation_bridge
entries.purpose: Use the proven Gemini CLI route to analyze V39 recovery artifacts and emit bounded machine-readable recommendations.

entries.name: vesper_runtime_bridge
entries.purpose: Extend Vesper Ion's Bigtable durable-memory bridge with V39 runtime telemetry and read-back verification.
entries.rollback_or_cleanup: delete the V39 Bigtable table if the runtime bridge is intentionally retired

entries.name: pillar_bundle_publisher
entries.purpose: Publish explicit Mind, Body, and Heart V39 proof bundles with PASS/WARN/FAIL posture.
entries.rollback_or_cleanup: replace with a fresh bundle on later phases; no external side effects

entries.name: v39_surface_publisher
entries.purpose: Update runtime truth and publish the V39 Omega closeout plus the V40 Beta handoff pack.
entries.rollback_or_cleanup: re-run after suite or git state changes
